tasks.title: Create model 'lab-unrelate' and deploy applications
tasks.instructions:
Create model `lab-unrelate` and deploy two `haproxy` instances named `gateway` and `api-service`:

```bash
juju add-model lab-unrelate
juju deploy haproxy gateway --channel latest/stable
juju deploy haproxy api-service --channel latest/stable
```

Verify both applications exist:

```bash
juju status
```
hints: Run `juju add-model lab-unrelate` then deploy both applications.
tasks.solution:
```bash
juju add-model lab-unrelate
juju deploy haproxy gateway --channel latest/stable
juju deploy haproxy api-service --channel latest/stable
```

tasks.title: Integrate 'gateway' and 'api-service'
tasks.instructions:
Integrate `gateway:reverseproxy` and `api-service:website`:

```bash
juju integrate gateway:reverseproxy api-service:website
```

Verify integration in `juju relations`:

```bash
juju relations
```

tasks.title: Break relation between 'gateway' and 'api-service'
tasks.instructions:
Sever the integration between `gateway` and `api-service`:

```bash
juju remove-relation gateway:reverseproxy api-service:website
```

Verify that the integration is removed:

```bash
juju relations
```
